notes: Adds task status mutations and optimistic checkboxes, comment threads and replies, attachment upload/download services, photo selection and upload progress, attachment-reference message sending, and inline transcript/note images with download/open actions. Earlier pairing, conversation, workspace, note, protocol, and cache features remain. Android is unreleased; live-device verification, note editing, video import, model selection, Tailcat, full rich rendering, and remaining iOS features are under development.
